text:
tanya (curation): heads-up — final scrub for the model catalog launch tomorrow. i pulled together a quick checklist but need owners for a couple late items: (1) licensing confirmation for 3 new open models, (2) perf profile for short-chat vs long-context, (3) infra canary window. who can own each?

raj (ml-eng): i can take perf profiles. have quick microbench numbers but need consistent input shapes from curation. do we want embedding shapes too or just gen? :thinking_face:

tanya (curation): start with gen profiles (short/long) and one embedding shape check. i'll drop canonical prompts.

liam (infra): i can own the canary window + capacity. current reserved pool has room for 2 low-priority canaries at T+2h. need exact qps and mem for each model.

ben (platform): i'll make the rollout config + A/B flags. pls add the model ids to the deploy manifest `manifests/catalog-launch-2026.yaml`. cc @deploy-bot for schedule.

sophie (legal): licensing quick note — one of the models has an atypical CLA note in the repo. i need the vendor confirmation before we mark it GA. ETA midday tomorrow unless vendor responds earlier.

raj (ml-eng): pinging the perf checklist i ran earlier:
```
models: [ocean-7b-open, pebble-6b-v2, aurora-lite]
short_ctx: 128 tokens
long_ctx: 2048 tokens
batch: 1,4,8
metrics: p50_lat_ms, p95_lat_ms, tokens/s, mem_peak_mb
```
results are noisy for aurora-lite at 2048 (p95 spikes) — likely kv-cache overhead. i can run quantized variant later today.

liam (infra): noted. for canary sizing, what's the expected burst qps for aurora-lite and pebble? i can map to nodes.

raj (ml-eng): short_ctx qps target = 80 qps for aurora-lite, pebble = 40. long_ctx steady = 6 qps each. that should be enough to exercise tails.

liam (infra): ok that'll fit into two nodes with autoscale disabled during canary. i'll schedule a 1-hour canary at T+2h with 10% traffic shift, then a 30m 30% increase if stable.

ben (platform): i've queued the manifest change PR: https://repo/redwood/platform/PR-7890 — needs one approval from `eng-ml` and one from `platform` to merge. can someone review? small YAML tweak: `rollout.strategy: canary -> 10/30`

raj (ml-eng): i'll review now. can also add the perf artifact link to the PR.

tanya (curation): legal blocker — sophie, if vendor can't confirm by noon, can we soft-gate that model behind `beta` flag and launch catalog without it?

sophie (legal): yes we can soft-gate. prefer that over delaying whole catalog. i still want the vendor confirmation tracked in the catalog entry. i'll update the legal field.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job `catalog/launch-2026` created for 2026-09-15T18:00Z (canary T+2h). See job/12987 for logs.

tanya (curation): thanks — two remaining things: (A) ping on CR for the model metadata schema change (someone from eng-ml?), (B) confirm embedding shape we should advertise.

raj (ml-eng): i'm on the schema CR — PR 7892 i left a small comment about `context_window` vs `max_tokens`. will resolve today. embedding shape: 1536 dims for pebble, 1024 for aurora-lite, 2048 for ocean-7b.

ben (platform): merged the rollout PR after raj's review. staging manifest updated. i'll hold final prod merge till canary passes per liam's checks.

liam (infra): canary health probes: p95 < 800ms for short_ctx, CPU < 75% on nodes, mem < 70%. if any fail, auto rollback. i'll post results in this thread.

raj (ml-eng): quick note about aurora-lite perf — attaching short sample snippet i used to repro tail: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"aurora-lite","prompt":"<long convo>"}'
# look for p95 spikes in APM
```

tanya (curation): perfect. i'll push the canonical prompts and vendor contact info to the catalog entry now. thanks all — will follow up once canary completes. :thumbsup:

sophie (legal): added `vendor_contact` and `license_status: pending` to ocean-7b entry. will update to `cleared` if vendor replies.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-09-15T20:02:00Z, job/12987. monitoring hooks active.

liam (infra): canary first 10 minutes look good: p95 short_ctx aurora-lite = 420ms, pebble = 360ms, node CPU avg = 52%. continuing.

raj (ml-eng): seeing the same in APM traces. no errors in logs. i'm running a longer long-context pass now (20m).

liam (infra): ok increasing to 30% traffic.

deploy-bot: canary scaled to 30% at 2026-09-15T20:18:00Z.

liam (infra): canary green. promoting to prod per config. rolling update scheduled. all owners: expect brief reconnections (~5s) for active streams.

tanya (curation): amazing — thanks everyone. i'll mark ocean-7b as `beta` for now and finish catalog notes. any post-launch follow-ups, post here and i'll triage. :sparkles:
